onboardingMessages: 🛡️ Firewall Bot is now active! Your group is protected with smart moderation, security locks, and automated actions.
⚙️ Setup Required: Please promote Firewall Bot to Administrator with permissions to: • Delete messages • Ban users • Manage chat
💡 Pro Tip: For better performance and to avoid conflicts, consider removing other moderation bots from this group.
settings.gpidHelpText: Share the group ID or forward a message so the bot can detect it automatically.
settings.commands: 📚 Quick Guide To get started, explore these key commands: • !lock link — Block Telegram links • !filter word — Filter a keyword • !ban 24 — Ban user (reply) • !mute 1 — Mute for 1 hour (reply) 💡 For the best experience, configure your settings in the Mini App right after setup.
settings.infoCommands: 🚀 Firewall was created and is continuously developed with care by @iamSeyyed. 🙏 Special thanks to @maxim, @username, all server admins, the development team, supporters, and every user who reports bugs or suggests new features — your feedback keeps this project alive. 💬 We deeply appreciate every group that uses Firewall. Your trust is our motivation — and we'll keep making Firewall stronger every day. 🔥
